messages.subject: selectInput and css
parts:
Hello,
 I am building a shiny app that sometimes is seen as a stand alone web-page, and sometimes is seen as an iframe in another web-page. When it is in an iframe has a much smaller width to work with. To deal with this I have created 2 .css files and have some JavaScript in ui.r that detects if it is in a frame or not and uses the appropriate .css.

I am having a problem trying to correctly apply styles to  the selectInputs. I have three of them in  a .row and I would like to put them side by side - the label text would still be above the select box, but the three boxes would be horizontally aligned.

I have found by inspecting elements that class label.control-label styles the label and can be used to put labels and select boxes on the same line, and that the class shiny-bound-input refers to the select box, but also to other things like download buttons.

I had naively expected that there would be a class that referred to the entire control - label plus dropdown box. Is there such a a class? If not, how should change the .css to make these align correctly?

Thanks

John Paul
